description.sl: Kultura s teto Nives: razstava in galerija, kip in umetnina, gledališki oder in igralec, režiser in občinstvo, premiera, ploskati, ocena, kulturna dediščina in rokodelstvo, festival, mozaik, freska, umetnostna zgodovina, vstopnica in blagajna, vodeni ogled, navdih.
description.en: Culture with Zia Nives: the exhibition and the gallery, the statue and the work of art, the stage and the actor, the director and the audience, the first night, a review, heritage and crafts, the festival, the mosaic and the fresco, the box office, the guided tour, inspiration.
